gb_source_checks.ga_binding_composition_rule: header 'p cnf 509915 5740268' -> 'p cnf 509915 5740394' (clause count + 126, variable count unchanged); weak body and the 42 unit lines unchanged and in place; the M_s tail appended after the last unit line

storage_replacement.replaced: module global F of the generation module object -> subclass of the pinned F overriding __init__ (adds the sink, sets F.cl = None) and c(*lits) (appends the ASCII bytes of ' '.join(map(str, lits)) + ' 0\n' to a bytearray segment; 16 MiB segments frozen as bytes)
storage_replacement.unchanged: F.new, F.n, F.tab, encode() and every nested GB function (pinned bytes executed as-is)
storage_replacement.why_encoding_cannot_change: gb_source_checks.gb_ast_facts: encode uses its F instance only via F_.new(...) calls and F_.c(...) expression statements, never reads F_.cl/F_.n/F_.tab, never aliases F_, creates it by a bare F(); the per-clause bytes equal main()'s line for list(lits); header from F.n and the count of c() calls as in main()

conventions.units: 42 lines '%d 0\n' (ASCII, LF): for i = 2..7 ascending, c = 1..7 ascending: +v if c in WMAN supports_row2to7[i-2] of the template, else -v; v = GB F.tab[('g',1,(0,c),(i,0))] (square 1)
conventions.tail: 126 lines '%d %d 0\n' % tuple(sorted((-a,-b))): i = 2..7 ascending, (c,d) in itertools.combinations(1..7, 2); a = F.tab[('g',s,(0,c),(i,0))], b = F.tab[('g',s,(0,d),(i,0))]
conventions.template_formula: 'p cnf V C+42\n' + GB base body (unchanged) + 42 unit lines
conventions.strengthened_formula: 'p cnf V C+42+126\n' + GB base body + the source template's 42 unit lines + the M_s tail
conventions.V: GB F.n (unchanged by units/tails: every appended id is an existing GB primary id)
conventions.source: GA parent bindings parent_binding_v1.py (units) and bind_v1.py/BINDING.json (tail, headers); exact lines checked in gb_source_checks

Square-1 ids are used for the 42 units (Q1 column-0 templates), as in the GA leaves and the brief.
No 'c' comment lines, LF only, single spaces, as main() writes; the strengthened tail follows the last unit line (GA bind_v1 composition).
